caption: The drawing depicts a single large ceramic jug with a handle and a narrow mouth, set against a plain, light background. The jug is colored in shades of beige and light brown with darker shading to indicate contours and volume. There is a blue floral or botanical decorative pattern on the front, featuring large petals and oval shapes. Near the top of the jug, blue text reads “RENINGER CARR / POUGHKEEPSIE NY” along with a blue number "2". The rim of the jug’s mouth is a darker brown, and there is a small irregular patch on its surface that suggests a chip or worn area. The bottom edge of the drawing contains printed words: "WESTCHESTER COUNTY" on the lower left and "HOWARD N. LUMBARD" on the lower right. The overall composition centers on the jug, with no other objects present and the background left unadorned and neutral.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
